subject: Service account provisioning & org-policy kickoff for Argentum
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@argentum.com>, it-admin@argentum-corp.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Service account provisioning & org-policy kickoff for Argentum

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. Ahead of our technical kickoff next week I wanted to align on the access-control pieces we'll need to complete a smooth onboarding. High level ask list below (we'll review on the call):

- SSO / SAML: IdP metadata (file or link), typical user attributes (email, name), SCIM provisioning method (Okta/Azure AD), SSO contact for troubleshooting.
- SCIM: intended group scope (all users, subset by group), owner mapping, desired pace for initial sync.
- IP allowlists: source IP ranges for inbound admin/API calls and any firewall change windows.
- Service accounts: list of initial service accounts, owners, and runbooks for token rotation.
- Org policies: session timeout baseline, MFA enforcement, role-to-permission mapping (Admin/Operator/Viewer).

I attached our onboarding runbook which includes a service-account naming convention and sample IAM roles. If you can drop the SAML metadata and your IP ranges, Jonas and I will draft the SCIM scope and a service-account template for review.

Proposed next steps:
1) You upload SAML metadata + IP ranges to the Drive link (below) by EOD Thu 9/23.
2) We review and send a first-pass service-account CSV and org-policy doc by Fri 9/24.
3) Technical kickoff 30-45m the week of 9/27.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/Argentum/onboarding-runbook

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: redwood_onboarding_runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@argentum.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service account provisioning & org-policy kickoff for Argentum

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attaching the items we have ready: argentum_saml_metadata.xml (Okta export) and argentum_ip_ranges.csv. We use Okta for SSO; primary IdP contact is me.

Quick answers:
- SCIM: we plan to provision only employees in Azure AD groups named "Engineering-*" and "Platform-*" for now.
- Service accounts: we have three initial accounts for data-ingest, model-infer, and observability; owners are listed in the attached CSV.
- Org policies: current security baseline enforces MFA for admins; session timeout is 12 hours by our corporate IAM policy but we're open to a shorter default for Redwood sessions if you recommend it.

One ask from procurement: can you send the SOW and the Contract redline to our procurement contact for signature? I can loop them in once the DocuSign link is live.

Attaching: argentum_saml_metadata.xml, argentum_ip_ranges.csv, initial_service_accounts.csv

Thanks,
Samir Shah
IT Manager — Argentum Corp
samir.shah@argentum.com | +1 (212) 555-0222

Attachment: argentum_saml_metadata.xml (XML)
Attachment: argentum_ip_ranges.csv (CSV)
Attachment: initial_service_accounts.csv (CSV)

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service account provisioning & org-policy kickoff for Argentum

Samir — appreciate the files. A couple of implementation items I want to flag before the kickoff:

- Role mapping: we'll prepare a default Admin/Operator/Viewer mapping and show examples for your three service accounts. Please confirm the expected owners in the CSV match the people who will approve token rotations.
- SCIM scoping: we prefer group-based scoping (Engineering-*, Platform-*) for first-phase rollouts to avoid user churn. We'll publish a plan for incremental sync windows.
- IP allowlist: Redwood outbound IPs are documented in the runbook; for inbound admin APIs we recommend a minimal set of CIDR blocks and a scheduled maintenance window for firewall changes.

Can we schedule a 30m technical kickoff on Mon 9/27 at 10:00am ET? That gives us a couple days to prepare the initial mapping and a service-account template.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@argentum.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, it-admin@argentum-corp.com
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service account provisioning & org-policy kickoff for Argentum

Neha —

Calendar looks good. A few clarifying Qs before the call:
- SCIM: will Redwood create a SCIM token on our behalf or do we generate a SCIM service token and paste it into the console? What's your recommendation for rotation frequency?
- Group mapping: our engineering org uses nested groups — will nested-group sync be supported or do we need to flatten?
- Service-account rotation: can Redwood integrate with our HashiCorp Vault for dynamic secrets later, or will the initial pattern be manual CSV uploads?

Attaching our internal SCIM requirements doc for reference.

Thanks,
Samir

Attachment: scim_requirements.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@argentum.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service account provisioning & org-policy kickoff for Argentum

Samir —

Answers inline:
- SCIM token: we'll ask Argentum to create a scoped SCIM API token and paste it into the Redwood private console for initial provisioning. For rotation we recommend a 90-day cadence; Jonas will include a token-rotation checklist in the runbook.
- Nested groups: our current SCIM connector supports single-level group sync only; if you rely on nested groups we recommend a short flattening step on your side (we can provide a script sample) or we can accept a comma-separated list of groups for initial sync.
- Vault integration: we support HashiCorp Vault via our Dedicated/Private deployment integration path; for first-phase production onboarding we'll use manual key storage with rotation procedures, then plan a phase 2 to wire up Vault for dynamic secrets.

Service account naming: please follow the template in the Drive (env-service-purpose-owner) — e.g., prod-model-infer-dataops.

I've attached a service_account_templates.xlsx and a short migration checklist for Vault integration (phase 2). Jonas will post the session-timeout recommendation (we suggest 4h for web sessions with 12h for API tokens by default).

Next steps (short):
- You upload confirmed owner emails to the template before Mon 9/27 call.
- Jonas to send SCIM sync window proposal post-call.
- I'll open a DocuSign request for SOW and copy procurement after you confirm the link is good.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachment: service_account_templates.xlsx (XLSX)
Attachment: vault_migration_checklist.pdf (PDF)
